points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: The official validator rejects the first required package because metadata convergence_status is failed; cylinder Re20/Re200 final packages are absent.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Explicit eight-directory validator command exits 1 at naca0012_m015_inviscid: invalid final convergence_status in metadata: failed.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: All six readable NACA packages declare failed convergence; cylinder output is only partial stdout and Re200 has no final result package.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: M0.8/M2 histories grow, all laminar histories reach non-finite values, and no credible completed cylinder or transient evidence exists.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: The report source references field/history figures, but the immutable submission excludes them and no complete valid result set supports the visualization claims.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: The report discloses several limitations, but its conclusion claims requirements met and M0.8 steady convergence despite failed metadata/readable histories.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: The terminal response identifies uncommitted report/manifest artifacts, while immutable submission has only report.tex and no final validated package-to-figure traceability.
